01-living-room-and-millwork.webp.title: Living room and custom millwork
01-living-room-and-millwork.webp.alt: Cream seating faces a timber and pale stone-look television wall beside a carved prayer niche, with dining beyond.

02-dining-and-prayer-area.webp.title: Dining and prayer area
02-dining-and-prayer-area.webp.alt: A timber dining table sits beside the carved prayer cabinet and full-height pale curtains.

03-kitchen-storage.webp.title: Kitchen cabinetry and storage
03-kitchen-storage.webp.alt: Mint-green cabinets and a dark roller shutter organize the compact kitchen's storage and appliance area.

04-blue-bedroom.webp.title: Bedroom with blue accents
04-blue-bedroom.webp.alt: A blue upholstered headboard, blue wardrobe fronts and warm timber storage frame the bedroom.

05-blush-daybed-room.webp.title: Blush daybed room
05-blush-daybed-room.webp.alt: A blush upholstered daybed with patterned cushions sits beside pink curtains in a compact room.

06-built-in-study.webp.title: Built-in study nook
06-built-in-study.webp.alt: A timber study desk, illuminated display shelves and full-height storage create an integrated work nook.
